Which of the following equations could be used to describe the graph shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The given curve is the graph of $y=cos⁡x.$

Notice that, because the cosine function is even, it is symmetric about the $y$-axis, i.e.,

$$
cos⁡(-x)=cos⁡x
$$

So the graph could also be viewed as $y=cos⁡(-x).$
